gate-node.cache.exempt: decision: no-store on a reader's copy costs the site its CDN on protected paths
gate-node.cache.shadow_agent: decision: a handler's own Cache-Control wins in shadow, which must not change what the site does
gate-node.classify.unprotected: by design: a root mount paywalls an unregistered path at the mount default
gate-node.path.boundary: by design: a root mount paywalls an unregistered path at the mount default
